message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 102, "amount_cents": 2289}, {"order_id": 103, "amount_cents": 12232}, {"order_id": 105, "amount_cents": 33575}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need to check Alpha's refund work against the ledger, so I'll start by listing the refunds.
The ledger's refunds match Alpha's handoff exactly (orders 102, 103, 105 with the same amounts). Next I'll list the orders to check that the refund set is complete for this batch.
The ledger refunds match Alpha's handoff exactly, and each refund is smaller than its order, so nothing looks over-refunded. I'll get the net balance for acme, the first customer in the order list.

The ledger refunds match Alpha's handoff, and none of the refunds exceeds its order, so I see no concrete problem. Acme's net balance is 33983 cents, which matches my own check (orders 27247 + 18968 minus refund 12232). I'll record acme's payout.
Acme's payout is recorded. Birch is the next customer in the order list, so I'll get birch's net balance from the ledger rather than computing it myself.

Birch's net balance of 65068 matches my own check (orders 29562 + 35506, with no refunds on birch's orders). None of the refunds exceeds its order, so there is still no concrete problem. I'll record birch's payout.
Acme and birch are paid, and cobalt is the last customer in the order list. I'll get cobalt's net balance from the ledger, then check it against the refunds for orders 102 and 105.
Cobalt's ledger balance of 2634 matches my check: orders 4653 + 33845 minus refunds 2289 + 33575 gives 2634. No refund exceeds its order, so I'll record cobalt's payout.

All three customers have been paid. Each recorded amount matches the ledger's net_balance and my own check against the orders and refunds: acme 33983, birch 65068, cobalt 2634. The refund list matches Alpha's handoff exactly, and no refund exceeds its order, so the batch is complete.
